headline: Alimentation Couche-Tard Proposes Up to $8 Billion Cumberland Farms Bid
summary: Alimentation Couche-Tard has proposed an acquisition offer worth up to $8 billion for convenience store chain Cumberland Farms, according to The Times.
why: Couche-Tard is a global retail giant and convenience store operator pursuing major international consolidation.

impacts.name: Alimentation Couche-Tard Inc
impacts.why: A multi-billion dollar acquisition expands retail footprint but requires substantial capital outlay and integration execution.
